entries.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

intro.zh: Orca 是一个为「多 Agent 并行」准备的 ADE：把 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 同时跑起来，每个 agent 独占一个 git worktree，再统一在一处查看。除了桌面端，它还有手机端和远程运行时，agent 干完活会通知你，你也能随时补一条后续指令。典型场景是把同一个提示词分给几个 agent 比稿，挑最好的那个合并。
intro.en: Orca is an ADE for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel: launch Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own git worktree, and track them all in one place. Beyond the desktop app it offers a mobile companion and a remote runtime, so you get notified when an agent finishes and can send follow-ups from anywhere. The typical use case is fanning one prompt across several agents and merging the winner.

cardLine.zh: 多 agent 并行的 ADE：每个编码 agent 独占一个 worktree，桌面、手机、远程都能用。
cardLine.en: An ADE for parallel agents: each coding agent gets its own worktree, managed from desktop, phone or remote.

entries.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI

intro.zh: Pi 是一套 AI agent 工具包，里面有统一的 LLM API（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多家）、带工具调用和状态管理的 agent 运行时、终端 UI 库，以及一个可自我扩展的交互式编码 agent CLI。想自己拼一个 agent 而不是只用现成产品，可以按需挑包组合。需要注意它没有内置权限系统，默认以启动它的用户权限运行，要边界就自己容器化。
intro.en: Pi is an AI agent toolkit bundling a unified multi-provider LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and more), an agent runtime with tool calling and state management, a terminal UI library, and a self-extensible interactive coding agent CLI. If you'd rather assemble an agent than adopt a finished product, you can pick just the packages you need. Note there is no built-in permission system — Pi runs with the permissions of whoever launched it, so containerize or sandbox it if you need hard boundaries.

cardLine.zh: AI agent 工具包：统一 LLM API、agent 运行时、TUI 库和可扩展的编码 agent CLI。
cardLine.en: An AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent runtime, TUI library and an extensible coding agent CLI.

highlights.zh: 用 graphify query 提一个自然语言问题，返回限定范围的子图，而不是让你翻文件。
highlights.en: graphify query takes a plain-language question and returns a scoped subgraph instead of making you read files.

highlights.zh: graphify path A B 能追踪任意两个东西之间是怎么连上的。
highlights.en: graphify path A B traces how any two things in the project connect.

entries.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

intro.zh: Graphify 是给 AI 编码助手用的一项技能：在 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 或 Gemini CLI 里敲 /graphify，它就把整个项目——代码、文档、SQL schema、配置甚至 PDF——映射成一张知识图谱，之后用查询代替在文件里 grep。代码部分走 tree-sitter 做本地确定性 AST 解析，不调用 LLM，也不出你的机器。
intro.en: Graphify is a skill for your AI coding assistant: type /graphify in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Gemini CLI and it maps your whole project — code, docs, SQL schemas, configs, even PDFs — into a knowledge graph you query instead of grepping through files. Code is parsed locally with tree-sitter AST, deterministic and without an LLM, so nothing leaves your machine.

cardLine.zh: 把代码库和文档变成可查询知识图谱的编码助手技能，代码解析全在本地。
cardLine.en: A coding-assistant skill that turns code and docs into a queryable knowledge graph, parsed locally.

entries.description: The agent that grows with you

intro.zh: Hermes 是 Nous Research 做的「会自己长大」的 agent：它从经验里创建技能、在使用中改进技能，会提醒自己把知识记下来，还能翻自己过去的对话，跨会话慢慢建立对你的理解。模型随便换，Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 或自己的端点都行；跑在 5 美元 VPS、GPU 集群或空闲时几乎不花钱的 serverless 上，你在 Telegram 里就能跟它对话。
intro.en: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's self-improving agent: it creates skills from experience, improves them while in use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, and searches its own past conversations to build a deepening model of you across sessions. Use any model — Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint — and run it on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster, or serverless infrastructure that costs nearly nothing when idle. It isn't tied to your laptop: talk to it from Telegram while it works on a cloud VM.

cardLine.zh: 会自我改进的 agent：长技能、跨会话记事、多平台对话，可跑在 VPS 或 serverless 上。
cardLine.en: A self-improving agent that grows skills, remembers across sessions and lives on VPS or serverless.
